title: About Me
bio:
I am an experienced software engineer who love to solve technical difficulties to achieve certain goal with passion to pick up new things fast. I like making prototype solutions, scaling existing system like lego building blocks, performance optimization, using design pattern and better algorithm, devops and finding solution to automate process.

I've been in software engineering career for about 9 years with various industries, from software development firm, financial sector to payment and ecommerce provider.

I started working as junior software engineer at Myanmar Information Technology Pte Ltd, one of the biggest software development firm in Myanmar, since 2007. I've worked on various government projects, outsourced projects, HRM, CRM, CMS and Smart Home Automation System (x10 and upnp) and was promoted quickly to Senior Software Engineer and led a small team.

I've got a degree in Computer Science awarded from London Metropolitan University, UK in 2009.

Since then I've been working in Singapore as Senior Software Engineer in financial sector, payment and ecommerce. Currently, I am working for Hatcher Plus Pte Ltd as Senior Software Engineer to develop and maintain FAAST funding building and management platform, a one stop solution for fund manager and family offices.
subtitle: I use AI tools to assist in the development process, but I maintain full ownership and responsibility for all the systems, code snippets, and software listed on this site. Each project represents my work, creativity, and technical expertise, enhanced through the strategic use of AI technology.
